title: Stardew Valley Farm Planner & Layout Editor | Field & Farm
description: Design your Stardew Valley farm with eight terrain references, sixteen editable layout ideas, sprinkler coverage, building budgets and seasonal original pixel-style artwork.
guideText: Choose a farm terrain reference or practice landscape, start with initial structures or an empty grid, or preview one of 12 editable examples. Inspect crop coverage and base building costs. Reference flags are not verified live game terrain; artwork is independent.

title: Stardew Valley Community Center Bundle Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track standard Community Center bundles, seasonal requirements, remixed checklists and saved bundle definitions in a local workspace.
guideText: Track 30 standard bundles and the separate Missing Bundle. A merged private save can add positive donations only when a complete saved definition matches the standard reference. Nonmatching or remixed definitions remain available in a separate custom checklist.

title: Stardew Valley Museum Collection Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track 95 museum artifacts and minerals, filter acquisition routes, check donation rewards and arrange a practice museum display.
guideText: Discovery is not donation. Filter acquisition routes, review reward milestones and track donations. Arrange items on an original practice display grid, not the exact museum floor plan.

title: Stardew Valley Seed & Geode Predictor | Field & Farm
description: Predict Stardew Valley geodes, Golden Coconuts, Mystery Boxes, special mine floors, Traveling Cart stock and seeded events using documented reference models.
secondaryKeywords: stardew valley does luck affect geodes
guideText: Compare reference geode openings, Forest Cart and optional festival random stock, and seeded event dates. Does not generate world maps or crack game seeds. Independent game fixtures, fixed stock and exact save-day offsets remain pending.

title: Stardew Valley Save & Progress Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track Stardew Valley collections, skills, steps, friendship, orders, achievements, secret notes and story events using reference tools and optional private save inspection.
secondaryKeywords: how many steps have i taken stardew
stardew how many steps have you taken
guideTitle: Inspect a save without uploading it
guideText: Explore the collection overview and reference tools. In the private workspace, inspect and merge recognized save observations, then review individual players, milestones, orders and story markers. Unsupported fields remain unknown.

title: Stardew Valley Crop Profit Calculator & Planner | Field & Farm
description: Compare seasonal crop profits, expected harvest quality, planting budgets, rotations, reinvestment and processing options.
guideText: Compare seasonal and protected crop profits, expected quality, annual rotations and shared-machine cash flow. The fixed-planting daily economy also models kegs, jars, dehydrators, mill output and wine aging together. Tested policies are not global optima.

title: Stardew Valley Fair Grange Display Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Score and optimize a nine-slot Grange Display. Browse category-based example items and confirm actual sale values, qualities and available quantities.
guideText: Enter actual sale values, quality and Fair categories. In the private workspace, load recognized backpack and optional ordinary chest/fridge candidates; confirm availability and optimize the nine-slot display.

title: Stardew Valley Fish Collection Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track 72 fish entries and compare sale prices, difficulty, detailed acquisition locations, seasons, times and weather.
guideText: Filter the recorded main routes and compare detailed location-dependent acquisition references, difficulty and sale price tiers for 72 collection entries. Alternate sources and special bait may change conditions.

title: Stardew Valley Perfection Checklist & Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track Stardew Valley perfection goals, estimate weighted completion, compare multiplayer progress, and review individual collection items, friendship and Stardrop sources.
guideText: Review eleven weighted goals and individual collection checklists. Inspect reference friendship and Stardrop details; private save observations provide conservative evidence rather than certified exact completion.

title: Stardew Valley Crafting Recipes Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 149 crafting recipes, unlock sources, Trapper Crab Pot ingredients, material stock and costs, with private save stock opt-in.
guideTitle: Prepare a batch of crafting recipes
guideText: Plan direct crafting ingredients and costs, choose Trapper substitutions, and optionally use recognized local inventory observations in the private workspace.

title: Stardew Valley Shipping Collection Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Search 154 shipping items by category and common acquisition season, review source hints and export missing items or saved progress.
guideText: Find the 154 reference entries by category, common acquisition season or source hint. Mark actual in-game shipping, not possession or shop sales. Export the missing list; seasonal hints are not exhaustive.

title: Stardew Valley Cooking Recipes Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 81 cooking recipes, unlock sources and prices, select substitute ingredients and expand intermediate dishes with stock deductions.
guideText: Review cooking recipes, unlocks, grouped ingredient alternatives and intermediate dishes while deducting available dish stock once. Crafting recipes are listed on the separate crafting page.

title: Stardew Valley Golden Walnut Tracker & Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 130 Golden Walnuts across 69 reference task groups, review regional hints, recognized save markers and island upgrade spending.
guideTitle: Track lifetime finds separately from spending
guideText: Track regional walnut tasks and recognized positive save markers. Reference task mappings do not establish exact in-game locations or complete verified save compatibility.

title: Stardew Valley Farm Types Comparison | Field & Farm
description: Compare all eight Stardew Valley farm types, terrain flags, starter footprints, reachable reference capacity and editable farm layout ideas.
guideTitle: Choose a farm for your priorities
guideText: Compare all eight farm types using Wiki estimates and a separate same-source base terrain table. Switch access, buildability and tillability layers, sort the table, or open a farm-specific editable example. Reference flags are not exact current-game capacity.

title: Stardew Valley Grandpa Evaluation Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Calculate Grandpa evaluation points from earnings, skills, friendships and milestones. Check the four-candle threshold and remaining points.
guideText: Enter lifetime earnings, skill levels, friendships and completed milestones. Four candles require at least 12 points in the reference model. Record community center completion and its ceremony separately.

title: Stardew Valley Skills, Professions & Mastery Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track five skills, 30 profession effects and mastery experience. Load recognized XP and mastery stats locally in the private workspace.
guideText: Enter skill XP and mastery points, or load recognized main-player statistics and recorded vanilla profession IDs from a merged private save. Profession effects are not inferred from XP.
